finalText:
**Fixed the expiry check.**

`isExpired` used `token.exp < nowSeconds`, so a token whose expiry time had just arrived still counted as valid. The comment right above it says a token is expired the moment `exp` is reached, so the check is now `<=`.

All 5 tests pass in 0.06s.

One note: `node --test tests/` fails with `MODULE_NOT_FOUND` from that folder. Run `node --test tests/token.test.js` instead.
